subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw accept native Telegram album delivery now, and should it be exposed through the existing `mediaUrls` pipeline, a new explicit album action, or both?
rationale: Current main has the transport pieces to deliver multiple media items but not a native album path, and the open fork PR proposes a new action/API shape that may conflict with the existing `mediaUrls` contract.

options.title: Review or port the fork PR
options.body: Use the existing fork PR as the implementation candidate, but require a current-main port, API-shape review, focused tests, and real Telegram album proof before merge.

options.title: Queue a fresh implementation
options.body: Supersede the fork PR and implement album grouping directly on the current `mediaUrls` delivery paths to avoid adding a parallel action surface.

options.title: Defer album behavior
options.body: Keep current sequential fan-out behavior and leave native Telegram albums unimplemented until a maintainer sponsors the product surface.

recommendation.title: Review or port the fork PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing fork PR as the implementation candidate, but require a current-main port, API-shape review, focused tests, and real Telegram album proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already provided the maintainer cleanup direction on this issue and has adjacent outbound/media history through Peter Steinberger commits.
